name: business-starter
description: Start and run any kind of business with a multi-agent HQ: the main chat orchestrates 16 specialist department subagents (market, competitors, customers, strategy, brand, product, finance, legal, marketing, content and social, sales, commerce, retention, operations, fundraising, red team), tailored by 16 business-type playbooks, with go/pivot/kill gates and deterministic scripts for every number.
